items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: I used to hear Ray, Ray Nance was with that band at that time

ctx.x: this at home. All we had was an old gramophone and played records, you know. But we would go over to my neighbor's and listen to Hines, who at that time was working the Grand Terrace in Chicago. And this was broadcast, used to come over the works, and it would come to Lake Charles. And we would stay up at night and listen to this. We'd go and listen. I think they were on every night, at least five nights a week or something like that, from the Grand Terrace, which was a beautiful, wonderful thing. And I was so --…
He could play up a breeze and a storm, and then it comes back to my mind I used to hear Ray, Ray Nance was with that band at that time, when they played the Grand --
You heard Ray on the radio.
